title: sle-periop-gc-analysis: analysis code for a head-to-head cohort study of early ICU glucocorticoid dose in systemic lupus erythematosus versus rheumatoid arthritis
description: Extraction and analysis code accompanying a multi-database observational study in which the underlying rheumatic diagnosis (systemic lupus erythematosus versus rheumatoid arthritis) was treated as an effect modifier of the association between early intensive-care-unit glucocorticoid dose and 30-day mortality. The repository holds the numbered analysis pipeline: schema probes, cohort extraction from MIMIC-IV v3.1 with external cohorts in eICU-CRD v2.0 and NWICU, narrative-annotation corpora built from discharge summaries, Firth-penalised interaction models with robustness and negative-control batteries, and the measurement-validation programme for the text phenotype (blinded double coding, out-of-sample replication, rule ablation, human adjudication). No patient-level data are included: all source databases are governed by PhysioNet data-use agreements, so users must obtain credentialed access and run the extraction scripts under their own DUA.
